comparison.objective: Play three specified notes in order on a lap steel guitar using a tone bar, then return the bar and withdraw both hands.
comparison.physical_skill: Position a tone bar at color-coded neck locations while plucking and timing notes versus hold a mandrel coaxially while delivering regulated impacts and recovering fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Correct ordered notes each ring for half a second, bar returned, and hands withdrawn versus four tangs fractured/recovered with no insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Bimanual tool-plus-strike/pluck coordination is superficially shared, but controlled musical excitation and timing are different from destructive notch fracture and debris containment. Pitch tolerances are not specified.
